key_insight: LF-ENN combines neural approximation with structure-preserving enrichment to provide a rigorous locking-free guarantee for nearly incompressible linear elasticity.
engineering_relevance: The method supports accurate displacement prediction near incompressibility without the artificial stiffening caused by volumetric locking.
method: Enrich a linearized neural trial space within an enriched Galerkin framework.
Reduce discrete incompressibility constraints to a graph-Laplacian problem, enabling divergence-free corrections.
Use Nitsche boundary enforcement and tailored stabilization.
evidence_signal: Two- and three-dimensional experiments confirm locking-free behavior; a reported comparison achieves approximately 12× smaller displacement error than a higher-order locking-free enriched Galerkin method using fewer than one-third as many unknowns.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees require suitable approximation and mesh-resolution assumptions; fewer unknowns do not alone establish lower computational cost.
paper_title: A locking-free enriched linearized neural network for linear elasticity
